title: Client holding statement (NSE / BSE API, JSON)
purpose: The trading member's own demat accounts (pool, own, client unpaid, client collateral, invoked margin and MTF pledges, early pay-in…), each account and ISIN with its NSE account type (POOL, CM COLL, OWN, EPI, CLNTBENE-MTF, TMCOLL, TMCOLL-MTF, CLNT UNPAID, CLNT COLL, MRGN PLEDGE, MTF PLEDGE, CLNTBENE), security type (EQ, MF, BOND, DEBT, PREF, IDR, WT, COMM; a commodity also has its name and unit, GMS, KG, QUINTAL, MT, BARRELS, MMBTU, BALES, DRUMS or OTHERS, else NA) and the member's own client code, PAN and name (NSE/INSP/55039, NSE/INSP/55380 Annexure A). Not clients' holdings in their own accounts, and not securities clients pledged as margin (NSE FAQ on margin collection).
linked: Written from the day's balances of the firm's demat accounts (kept by day from CDSL's statement of holding; a Saturday, holiday or Sunday session takes the latest since the last trading day), for the accounts tagged in Settings → Firm demat accounts; security types from CDSL's ISIN master; not made while an account of no client is untagged (firmdemats.go)
